fics.author: Adimnos
fics.summary: “I don’t believe you. You prefer me—“ “Compliant?” Rio stood slowly, her eyes never leaving Agatha’s face. The action put her inches away, her body heat radiating out, searing Agatha’s skin. “Obedient?” Agatha’s hips shifted against her will, her lips parting slightly. She closed her eyes against the heady mortification that razed through her chest. She felt Rio move closer and she parted her legs without thought. Rio stepped between them but didn’t touch, hands settling on the desk inches from Agatha’s hips and hands. “You always were such a brat .” Rio’s breath was hot against Agatha’s ear, her voice throaty and raw and filthy. “You never knew how to do what you were told.” Or: After five years away, a still-grieving Agatha is dragged back into the FBI and the arms of her ex-wife.

fics.title: An Unexpected Visitor
fics.author: ZimEyebright
fics.summary: The Darkhold's magic wavers for a mere moment as Wanda completes her enchantment over the town of Westview, yet a mere moment is all it takes for the shroud of Agatha's secrecy to slip and for Rio to find her. Agatha's camouflage fails long before Wanda steals her magic, Rio find her at the beginning of Wandavision, chaos ensues. X Rio however, didn’t look upset at all to see her. If anything she looked thrilled, shooting a wolfish grin at Agatha over Wanda’s shoulder, as if to say found you bitch . “Hello,” Wanda’s voice, which startled Agatha back into the present, was both infuriatingly pleasant and welcoming, “can I help you with something?” Rio’s sharp grin remained in place as those dark eyes of hers continued their slow perusal of Agatha's figure, taking her in from the bottom of her kitten heels, to the perfectly pinned dark curls around her face. At long last, her gaze slid away from holding Agatha hostage to answer Wanda’s question. “Hi neighbour, I was just passing by and thought it polite to introduce myself. I’m Rita Valdez, I live at number 17, just right down the street from here”.

fics.title: Death's Echo
fics.author: EchoesInTheMargins
fics.summary: When Rio joined Agatha on the witches' road, she wasn’t scared. If anything, she was cocky. The idea of walking the witches' road with her wife again felt like an adventure—an opportunity to be by Agatha’s side, even if Agatha clearly didn’t want her there. Rio thought it would be fun, familiar, despite the trials ahead. She had convinced herself nothing could touch her. But when the second trial arrived, everything changed. Rio found herself standing on the porch of the only home she had ever known—the home she shared with Agatha and their son, Nicholas. The witches’ road was ancient, as old as she was, and it had reached into her mind, plucked her deepest fear from the darkness she refused to acknowledge. It wasn’t a monster or some forgotten villain. It was a memory.

I quit.” That got Agatha's attention. Her head snapped up, eyes narrowing as she took in Rio's appearance. Death looked... different. Touch was physical. Touch wasn't possible. Agatha pressed her fingertips down. As they pushed into the softness of the mattress, she frowned, she was in her bed. Agatha squinted her eyes open, keeping them narrow in case it was a trick. But no. It wasn't a trick. Stood in front of her, with a mop of brown hair falling over his little forehead was her son. Her boy. Her baby. ----- or What happens when Agatha gives in to Death's kiss and finally concedes the battle, only to wake up in an all too perfect world with her son and her wife? fics.summary: “I don’t want you here,” you say, practically hissing the words out through gritted teeth. Rio, damn her, merely huffs out a quiet, mirthless laugh as she slowly begins to walk two fingers up towards the tense line of your throat. She stops right at your clavicle, pressing lightly at skin in the dip between the bones. Everything inside of you burns with an ache you cannot name. “Okay, Agatha,” she echoes, this time in a whisper. It threatens to crack you open, to cut you down until there’s nothing left but a mess of blood and bone. Her dark eyes bore into yours, wide and depthless, a gulf between you vast enough to drown in. “If that’s what you want.” Then she pulls away. fics.summary: “You look like you just sprinted a mile,” Alice said, smirking. “Dr. Harkness give you a hard time today?” Rio dropped into the seat across from her, pulling her scarf loose and letting out a sigh. “No, not really. fics.title: here is the deepest secret nobody knows
fics.author: curiositysdarling
fics.summary: She’s always been a greedy thing, after all. Hungry, wanting. Grasping for more than she deserves, especially for things that so rarely come freely. Like the quicksilver joy that flashes through Agatha’s veins when Rio tugs her clothes back into place and lets her hands linger. Or the golden warmth that settles all the way down in her bones like river silt when Rio smiles at her so sweetly that crinkles appear in the corners of her eyes, right before she moves in for a kiss. It settles some of the awful, corrosive anger that lives in Agatha’s chest, the coal seam fire of you will never be good enough to matter that drives her so hard and pushes her so far. And at the core of it all is the simple fact that Agatha has never been able to let anything go easy, good or bad or downright ugly though it may be. She leans into every decision she makes like it’s her last, and this is no different. Triumph or failure, Agatha Harkness never does anything by halves. If this unnameable, intangible thing with Rio is a cliff, Agatha’s already flung herself well over the edge. // Agatha and Rio return to Hogwarts for their sixth year and find something new in the old rivalry that lies between them.

fics.title: this thread we'll never break
fics.author: curiositysdarling
fics.summary: In Agatha’s mind, divorce had simply been the next logical step to take in the wake of Nicky’s death and the resulting fractures that had formed between them, breaking apart the once-solid bedrock of whatever love they’d previously shared. But Rio’s face had gone white, bloodless, when Agatha had presented her with the papers. She’d begged, pleaded—gotten down on her knees , tears streaming down her cheeks, brown eyes wide and brimming with so much desperate hurt that Agatha had felt the sharp, hot press of it in her own chest like a knife—and Agatha hadn’t had anything left in her to push the issue. She’d relented, and the divorce papers had remained unsigned. Rio had packed her things and moved out without argument, allowed Agatha every other possible concession in the dissolution of their relationship—except divorce. Agatha hadn’t known why it mattered so much to Rio, remaining tied together on paper while everything else between them had dissolved in a slow, inevitable stop-motion avalanche of grief. Five years later, Agatha still doesn’t think she fully understands Rio’s reasoning. She’s finally grateful though—the hospital probably wouldn’t have called her about the accident otherwise.

fics.title: Decemberism
fics.author: kayniiine
fics.summary: As teenagers, Rio Vidal and Agatha Harkness fell into the all-consuming throes of young love on Christmas Day, 2002. It was their first kiss and the first of the thousands of kisses they would share over the next ten years of their lives. After years of masters and doctorate programs, their chosen career paths pulled them in opposing directions. Out of fear and misunderstanding, the relationship fell to pieces and left both parties irrevocably injured, never wanting to cross paths again. On Christmas Eve, Rio finds herself stranded with her car stuck in a snow bank and a nine hour waitlist for a tow. With a couple of miles to walk in the frigid cold, Rio begins her trek only to believe that someone has arrived to save her. When she turns around to view her knight, Agatha is the one that climbs out of the car. How much can change in a decade? Maybe, the more important question when it came to Agatha and Rio was instead: How much more could stay the same? Christmas AU One-Shot!

fics.summary: Everything about Agatha is fascinating—and it really shouldn’t be, considering the fact that Death has borne witness to countless lives across time from beginning to end. But there’s something rich and raw in the way that Agatha moves through the world, a heady, almost carnal enjoyment filling every indulgent aspect of life that she chooses to engage in. Even in the most mundane moments, Agatha’s enthralling. Death can’t look away from her. Agatha sits at a tavern and slyly flirts with the innkeeper’s daughter over a tankard of ale and a plate of carrot and potato stew—Death is a literal fly on the fucking wall. Agatha lures a witch—or two, or three—off into the woods and goads them into attacking her? Death arrives early to watch the show. Agatha goes to bathe in a nearby river, dark hair loosed from its typical braid, body glistening wetly, showcasing every minute movement of muscle beneath her soft, supple skin—well. All of a sudden, Death is fixated on the day-to-day details of mortal existence. Agatha, Agatha, Agatha. If Death had a heart, it would probably beat itself in the triplicate rhythm of her name. // A take on Rio and Agatha's backstory.

fics.summary: Rio clicked her pen shut, set her notebook down on the side table next to her and leaned forward in her seat, resting her elbows on her knees before speaking. “I want you both to know that this only works if you want it to work. I’m here to facilitate a productive conversation between you two. To find a way through whatever it is that you may be struggling with. There are no right or wrong answers here, no one is the hero or the villain. So, please, I need you both to contribute in order to move forward.” Rio’s eyes flickered between the women as she spoke. fics.author: Agatharioxoxo
fics.summary: At 32, a single mother of two with a high-powered career, her life was already overflowing with responsibility and carefully constructed order. Love, especially something unexpected, felt like a luxury she didn’t have time for. Then, at a Christmas party hosted by her best friend Wanda, Rio Vidal walked in. A confident, grounded doctor with a quiet warmth and an easy smile, Rio didn’t just turn Agatha’s head—she challenged everything Agatha thought she knew about herself. In a single evening, Agatha felt the walls she’d so carefully built begin to crack. And maybe, just maybe, she wasn’t afraid to let someone in.

Her hands shook. “No.” She whispered, to herself more than Dr Robbins. It didn’t make sense. It couldn’t be real. It couldn’t be happening again. But the doctor kept talking, giving her more details, repeating herself when she didn’t respond. And then- “Momma!” She sucked in a hiss of a breath at the sound of Nicky’s voice in the background — high, panicked, crying. “I need my Momma, please! Is she-” “I’ll be right there.” She blurted out, barely recognizing her own voice. OR, Agatha gets a call that her ex-wife, Rio, and son, Nicky, were in a car accident. Except, two years prior, the exact same situation caused the two to divorce.

fics.title: And They Were Roommates, to Say the Least
fics.author: WordsOnAWire
fics.summary: On the third day of Agatha's absence, Jen walked into the staff room, halfway through a bland bagel, when Rio looked up at her with a pout. "Agatha used to get cafeteria bagels," she sniffed. Jen let out an exasperated breath. "She hasn’t died, Rio. But you might soon, if you don’t get your shit together and stop sulking." "Here, look," Rio shoved her phone in Jen’s face. "She texted me this half an hour ago." She bit at her fingernail, looking genuinely worried. "Do you think she’s trying to ask me to come take care of her?" Jen squinted at the screen, reading the message: 'i cant find tortilla chips whered u hide them? xoxo' She felt herself age several years in that very moment. Slowly, she looked back up at Rio. "Your desperation is ruining my appetite. I’m finishing this bagel in my office." - Or, Jennifer Kale is the new school counselor, and everything is great. Well—almost. There's just one little snag. You know, the kind of snag that looks an awful lot like two emotionally dysregulated colleagues who can't help but make their situationship everyone else's problem?

fics.title: worth a thousand words
fics.author: curiositysdarling
fics.summary: “Let’s take a second, okay? I get it. You want this to feel natural, right? Not performative. You want these photos to be real.” Rio’s… Entirely right. Fuck. Am I really being that obvious? At a loss for words, Agatha just nods. “Okay. Bear with me, then. Let’s pretend we just met.” “No need to pretend there,” Agatha croaks out, trying to inject a note of levity into her words and failing miserably. Rio lets it slide, face breaking into a slight, indulgent smile. “Right. So we’re off to a great start already. We’ve just met, we’re becoming friends, and you’ve invited me over to hang out.” “Girls’ night,” Agatha offers, though she’s never before referred to any excursion with her friends as such in her life. “Yeah. Girls’ night. You’re showing me around, giving me a tour, now here we are. Two friends, just talking. Tell me about him—or her.” Rio’s smile widens encouragingly as she steps back, waving Agatha on. “It’s a boy,” Agatha admits, one hand moving to cradle her belly as she feels him start to squirm a little. He always seems to know when he’s the subject of conversation. // In which nervous new mom Agatha hires Rio for her maternity photos.

fics.summary: Rio, a florist living in New York, has spent years keeping her distance from her hometown and the people in it. She’s built a life on independence, casual flings, and avoiding attachments. But when her estranged stepsister, Jen, pressures her into returning to their small town to provide flowers for her wedding, Rio reluctantly agrees—mostly for the paycheck. Back home, Rio is immediately thrown back into the lives of Jen and her close-knit friend group, including Agatha, a single mom who has always been responsible and put everyone else first. Agatha has her hands full with her son, her failing bookstore, and dealing with her unreliable ex, Wanda. She doesn’t have time for distractions—especially not Rio, who she remembers as Jen’s aloof, rebellious stepsister who never seemed to care about anything.

fics.title: Second Chances
fics.author: Tiddiewitch
fics.summary: Seven years after losing the love of her life in a tragic accident, Agatha has built walls around her heart that seem impenetrable. A successful events coordinator with a sharp tongue and even sharper wit, she's learned to navigate life practically alone.But as Agatha's birthday approaches, she makes one final attempt at the dream she and her late wife once shared: having a child. With her friend Ralph as her donor, this may be her last shot at creating the family she's always wanted. Life has other plans. A chance collision in a bookstore with a mysterious woman leaves Agatha flustered in ways she hasn't felt in years. When the same stranger keeps appearing, Agatha finds her carefully controlled world beginning to crack. Complicating matters further, her estranged fundamentalist mother resurfaces with news of an unexpected inheritance from Agatha's grandfather, dragging her back into a past she's spent years trying to escape. Between managing high-stakes fundraisers, dodging her mother's manipulations, and trying not to think about the woman who makes her heart race every time they "accidentally" meet, Agatha discovers that sometimes the universe has plans that don't align with the ones we make for ourselves.

fics.title: I Still Shut My Eyes

fics.summary: Once upon a time, life was perfect for Agatha and Rio Harkness-Vidal. In their early thirties, they both had thriving careers and a home life that was made immaculate with the arrival of their son, Nicholas. Four months after his birth and after the recruitment of a nanny, Rio arrives home to an empty house and no trace of her son or the nanny. What first seemed hopeful carries on for twenty-five very long years until suddenly, the unthinkable happens. In The Big Apple, a mere car ride away from the Harkness-Vidal home in Newark, a twenty-five year old physical therapist who has always wondered about his mother's avoidance about his other parent decides to take an ancestry test. His girlfriend bought it for him for his birthday and, well, if his mother won't provide answers to his questions, he'll get them on his own. When his sample flags as a match to a two-and-a-half decade old DNA sample from a missing person's case, he gets far more of them than he ever could have imagined.

But then, suddenly, it was everything. One viral song, one breakout moment, and the life she thought she was building turned into something else entirely. But success came with a cost. Now, struggling with writer’s block and a career that feels stalled, Rio is forced to do the one thing she swore she’d never do—work with Agatha Harkness again. As late-night studio sessions turn into something heavier, as old wounds reopen and new truths come to light, Rio starts to realize that some things—some people—never really leave you. The real question is: can they build something new, or were they always destined to fall apart?

fics.summary: Rio stood, her movements slow and deliberate, like a predator that didn’t need to rush. "It means," she said, stepping toward her, "there are things about yourself, about us, that you’ve forgotten." Something cold curled around Agatha’s spine. "But you’re starting to remember now," Rio continued, her voice softer, more knowing. "Aren’t you?" And suddenly, she was. The image hit her like a slap, flashes of a dense forest, a hand gripping hers, laughter echoing in the trees, a warmth that felt like home. It was there, just out of reach, teasing at the edges of her mind. She staggered back, her breath catching. "What... what are you?" she whispered, voice barely audible. Rio’s lips curled into a faint smile. "That’s the right question, darling." Her eyes gleamed. "And when you’re ready to hear the answer, I’ll tell you." Or After Agatha's death, Rio waited for every day, year or timeline until her Agatha was reborn. And after a game, Agatha summoned Rio back into her life.

You need nutrients and sleep.” “I’m eating,” Agatha huffed without looking up from her monitor. Jen’s eyebrow arched like it had been trained for this exact moment. She folded her arms, the picture of relentless exasperation, “Yeah, and what is it that you’re eating?” Agatha gestured vaguely toward the side of her desk, where a wilted paper bag slumped beside her trash bin. “Whatever takeout my assistant brings. There are salads,” she added, defensive now. “So there—nutrients.” Jen didn’t blink. “You take one bite and then vanish into your work for seven hours straight. By the time the smell starts bothering you, it’s already spoiled. Then you throw it out and say you forgot. Again. Look, all I’m asking is to give it a try. fics.summary: No one visits Centralia, Pennsylvania. It’s been on fire for sixty years. It’s desolate. A ghost town. History books chronicle how the coal mines that tunneled under the entire length of the town mysteriously caught fire one day, and should have burned everything down instantly, killing everyone in their sleep. But, somehow, the fires have been entirely contained underground, rapidly burning, slowly poisoning. People whisper that it’s because a woman went mad here. Lore says it’s because of a little cursed book that would whisper to her, forcing her to carry out the most vicious acts. Ballads are sung about her thirst for blood and vengeance, her insanity, her grief . Rio Vidal knows it is because she talked to a blonde for fifteen minutes at the local bar. *** Or Agatha finds out that Rio *might* be moving on and malfunctions on a scale detrimental to an entire poor, mining town.

fics.summary: Agatha wakes up first. She doesn’t mean to watch Rio sleep, really, she doesn’t. But once it starts, she can’t seem to stop. Forty-seven minutes pass. She counts all of them. And in that time, she spirals through the quiet panic of realizing just how much she cares, how much this means, and how terrified she is of the fact that this—Rio, the bed, the safety, the love—might actually be real. When Rio wakes, she doesn’t need Agatha to explain. She knows. She feels it. And Agatha, still buzzing with too many feelings and not enough defenses, blurts out the one truth she can’t seem to hold in: “You make it better.” And Rio… pulls her in like it’s the most obvious thing in the world.

fics.title: for who goes up your winding stair can ne'er come down again
fics.author: curiositysdarling
fics.summary: Agatha smiles as Rio draws near. With bared fangs and eyes shining crimson with hunger, she looks every inch the apex predator Rio knows her to be. Anticipation thickens Rio’s blood, forcing her heart to pound harder, faster. They both know Agatha can hear it. Heat sparks at the base of her spine, moving upwards, catching fire. Rio shrugs off her leather jacket, plucks the wineglass from Agatha’s hand, and moves to straddle Agatha’s thighs like she belongs there. Here, there’s no need for pretense. No need to act like there’s any other way this encounter will end. Rio, who’s always enjoyed order, appreciates honesty wherever she can get it. “Someone’s eager,” Agatha croons. The observation might sting if it weren’t laced with such obvious fondness. Rio already enjoys their arrangement more than any sane person rightly should. “I’ve missed you,” Rio admits, breath catching as Agatha’s nimble fingers find the hem of her dress and begin bunching the fabric up and away. The whole way over here, she’d tried to keep the monetary aspect of this exchange at the forefront of her mind. But the truth of the matter is this: she’d let Agatha devour her for the simple pleasure of being so deeply and wholly desired.

fics.summary: Agatha let herself fall onto a plush little sofa by the office door. Her legs dangled over the armrest; her hair was fanning around her head. Ophelia drowning in a river of bullshit. "So what if I'm not likeable?" She asked the ceiling. "I'm an exceptional writer. You should remind the public of that instead of trying to marry me off to TikTok's favorite tradwife for PR!" "I want you to date Instagram's favorite baker for PR." Jen corrected her with the patience of an elementary school teacher. "Think about it, Aggs! Rio needs to officially come out and get rid of the tradwife rumors. You need relatability points with the public to promote your new book. It makes total sense. Two birds, one stone and all that." Agatha was too busy drowning to answer. — Or: At what point does 'pretending to be in love' turn into pretending not to be?

According to the rumor mill, a secret love affair with the conductor of the Scarlet Singers forced Agatha to quit and part ways with the choir she first found her voice in. Not keeping a bad bitch down, Agatha decides to follow her lifelong dreams to make a name for herself as the conductor of her own choir, the Coven Chorus. Rio Vidal, a child prodigy classical music performer, finishing her doctorate under Dr Lilia Calderu. For her final assignment she is challenged to explore other aspects of classical music performance and ends up having to audition for the Coven Chorus, the new trailblazing chamber choir on campus. Agatha, who has no time to inflate other’s egos, sees straight through Rio at the audition when the overconfident singer arrives. Something about Rio, be it her voice, confidence or just the way she stared down the great Professor Agatha Harkness, lets Agatha hesitate on taking a chance on Rio. An AU based in the competitive choir world where reputation isn’t the only thing on the line for Agatha Harkness.

fics.summary: Somewhere in the Caribbean Sea, a merchant ship is attacked by the Lady Death, a pirate ship commanded by the formidable, well-known and feared Captain Rio Vidal. The crew is quickly tied up and interrogated, including a young woman who introduces herself as Agnes. But she seems a little too elegant in her appearance, her clothes too neat, her hands too delicate, and when another prisoner reveals Agnes’s real name, her lie is exposed. Agatha Harkness, the only daughter of the powerful Governor Harkness, is unmasked. She has run away from her strict mother, who wants to marry her off to a rich man, and boarded the first ship that agreed to take her with them without asking questions. Seeing this as an opportunity to demand a large ransom from her mother, the captain decided to keep her alive rather than throw her overboard. But what he hadn’t anticipated was becoming so attached to her and to her presence on his ship; and as for Agatha, who was supposed to be treated as a prisoner, she hadn’t expected to feel freer on this ship than she had ever been in her entire life. And as the days went by, the thought that Agatha might one day return home, was becoming increasingly unbearable for both of them.

After years kept within the steel walls of the Cook County Coroner's Office, very little has come to challenge her anymore. That is, until a series of deceased men come across her table, all seemingly fine and yet, all in possession of a severed spinal cord. By the fifth body, Rio is beginning to saw her nose off to spite her face; not knowing how such a thing keeps happening, even if it is at the hands of another human being, starts to tilt her focus and skew her moral compass. How far will she go to get answers? Rio isn't even sure she knows.

fics.summary: The monarchy of The United Realms is teetering on the edge of collapse. As alliances fracture and public support plummets, Agatha Harkness — the First Princess and the last of her dynasty — is blindsided by a devastating ultimatum: she cannot claim her crown unless she takes a bride. Worse yet, her Regent has already selected the perfect match. Enter Rio Vidal, an outcast princess who openly scorns the nobility. Living like a rockstar and fronting an alt-indie band that rubs shoulders with anarchists, Rio despises the royals — and she hates the Harkness family most of all. But even the fiercest principles can be bought when the enemy of your enemy extends a hand. Bound by mutual hatred, neither woman believes this forced arrangement stands a chance of surviving. Yet, the fate of an entire nation — and their very lives — now rests entirely on this alliance. Welcome to a ruthless game of power. Tread carefully, because in The United Realms, betrayal is simply a matter of convenience, and checkmate always comes from the player you least suspect. The fall of one sovereign is merely the perfect opening for another to rise. or the royal dystopian au nobody has asked for but I wrote it anyway

fics.title: Into the Mirror
fics.author: kayniiine
fics.summary: At almost fifty years old, Rio has a life she never could have dreamed of as a child. As the Editor In Chief at Spotlight fashion magazine, she's got the job of her dreams and a life of luxury as a result. At the same time, the public presence side of it has never really been her thing. In fact, most would call Rio a recluse, but that's always been by design. When she comes home a day early from a business trip, the last thing she expects is to find her partner of thirty years in bed with another woman. While it should destroy her, Rio has never been and will never be the type to let anything sink her. So what does she do? She puts on a dress worth more than some people's salaries and plants her ass in some shitty dive bar in the middle of New York's East Village, ready to drink her night away and forget that in the matter of ten minutes, her life was turned upside down irrevocably. It just becomes a little harder when none other than world renowned rockstar Agatha Harkness decides to take the spot next to her, managing to change both of their lives forever without even realizing it.

fics.title: Beauty and the Botanist
fics.author: Cassie_Bones
fics.summary: “Ethcuse me?” A little fist appeared over the high counter, dropping a couple of wrinkled bills and some coins on the surface. Rio furrowed her brow, slipping off the stool and glancing over the counter to see a tiny face with big brown eyes and a wide smile, with the two front teeth missing, peering up at her. “Hello there,” Rio said, tilting her head curiously at him. “What can I do for you, little buddy?” “I wanna buy thome flowerth for my mama, pleathe,” he lisped, giving her that same charming little grin. Rio did not consider herself a kid person, per se, but this one was adorable. And so polite! She felt that cuteness aggression thing that people talk about when they see fuzzy little animals. OR Rio meets a little boy in her florist shop and is immediately charmed by his upbeat demeanor and adorable lisp. She helps him pick out some flowers for his mom and takes him back to her, immediately falling head over heels for the other woman, who offers to give her a manicure in exchange for the flowers. Rio accepts and the two make a standing appointment for every two weeks while the little boy starts to scheme... Part Imagine Me & You, Part Parent Trap AU All gay

fics.title: Obsessed
fics.author: forestgreentrees
fics.summary: “What are you doing here?” Rio asked. “Visiting your parents?” Wanda shook her head. “I live here now with my girlfriend. Oh!” she laughed as if she’d forgotten. “Agatha’s my girlfriend. Sorry, I should’ve led with that.” The mating dance appeared to have ended at the words because whatever flirtatious expression Rio wore was gone in an instant. “Oh wait that’s so sweet,” Rio smiled and Agatha could tell she genuinely meant it. “How long have you been together?” “Just over two and a half years,” Wanda beamed, snaking an arm around Agatha’s waist. For the first time in those two and a half years, Agatha wished she hadn’t. She couldn’t touch her in front of Rio when the other woman was clearly distraught that Agatha wasn’t available. OR: Agatha loves her girlfriend Wanda but when they bump into Wanda's ex, Rio, something shifts. She develops an unexplainable obsession with the other woman, eager to know everything about her. That obsession turns into something deeper and she soon realises she's with the wrong person.

fics.title: you look so cool when you're reading me
fics.author: perfection_located
fics.summary: "BAU's employee of the year speaking." "Do you ever sleep?" asks Rio. She swears she's never called Darcy during an active case and gotten a voicemail, even at the oddest hours. "After the photos in the coroner's report, it's gonna take me a minute before I feel like getting any shut-eye. But I know you didn't call me to chat about my excellent sleep hygiene." "No, I want you to run a search through VICAP and look for any cases on the east coast involving emasculation or castration of men ages twenty to sixty. I don't think this is the first time this unsub has killed." *** When the FBI’s Behavioral Analysis Unit is summoned to New Jersey to investigate a series of violent murders, Special Agent Rio Vidal becomes fascinated by the neighbor of one of the victims, who seems to have all the information they need to solve the case hidden somewhere behind her mischievous smile. Even as the team closes in on the unsub, Rio finds herself drawn further into Agatha's orbit - but she's becoming less and less sure the woman is all she pretends to be.
